statement: lagrange service init scaffolds a WASM-first project — lagrange.service.js with one HTTP route and one small distributed operation, a handler module unit-testable without WASM via fake calls and emit, package.json, README — that goes green through generate, build, and deploy against a local cluster, while service init --oci preserves the previous container scaffold and dev-install remains available as a low-level compatibility path.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The --oci path reuses service-project-scaffold.js output unchanged; dev-install behavior is unmodified, only de-emphasized in help text.
